uncited: HiFi4G is a 3D Gaussian Splatting variant designed for high-fidelity reconstruction of dynamic humans from monocular video.
It combines standard 3D Gaussian Splatting with a dual-graph mechanism to enable non-rigid tracking, ensuring spatial-temporal consistency while maintaining a compact representation.
It distinguishes itself from static 3DGS by explicitly modeling temporal deformation and from other dynamic methods by its specific dual-graph topology for tracking.
HiFi4G builds on [3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering (Software)](3410-3d-gaussian-splatting-rendering-software.md) by adding a temporal tracking layer.
It addresses the challenge of reconstructing dynamic humans from limited monocular input by leveraging the compactness of 3DGS and the tracking capabilities of a dual-graph structure.
